headline: Volkswagen’s slippery new EV breaks a bunch of efficiency records
summary: VW's Mission Efficiency EV prototype sets new efficiency records. It's built on the MEB+ platform as a 2+2 seat electric coupe. This vehicle is designed to be the world's slipperiest EV.

headline: Google’s Pixel 11 is cheaper ahead of iPhone 18 Pro launch
summary: Google's Pixel 11 phones are discounted, potentially due to the iPhone 18 Pro launch. The Pixel 11 Pro sees the biggest price drop to around $1,007. This deal significantly cuts the phone's recent price increase.

headline: Adam Conover explains how YouTube ruined everything
summary: Comedian Adam Conover discusses YouTube's negative impact on media. He shares insights from his career at CollegeHumor and TV. The discussion covers media evolution, labor, and AI.

headline: The four-hour-long Elon Musk documentary might be preaching to the choir
summary: Alex Gibney's new four-hour documentary chronicles Elon Musk's life story. It details his journey from dot-com millionaire to impacting government. The film offers a thorough retelling of his career.

headline: Discover Your Next Must-Play PC Game With Steam Hype
summary: Explore new PC games with Steam Hype to find your next favorite. Discover upcoming titles and hidden gems. Enhance your gaming library with curated recommendations.

headline: Walmart Has Knocked $50 off a Nintendo Switch 2 and Super Mario Galaxy 1&2 Bundle
summary: Walmart offers a Nintendo Switch 2 console with Super Mario Galaxy 1&2. The bundle is priced at $519. This deal saves buyers over $50 compared to buying items separately.

headline: Zack Snyder’s The Last Photograph Review
summary: Zack Snyder's 'The Last Photograph' receives a review. The film is described as an emotionless arthouse indie attempt. It explores Snyder's personal need to capture images.

headline: Metroid Dread Drops in Price for Nintendo Switch Following the Metroid Ravenous Reveal
summary: Metroid Dread's price has been reduced for Nintendo Switch. The discount is part of a 'Customer Appreciation' sale. This follows the recent reveal of Metroid Ravenous.

headline: Burnham cancels engagements after death of his father
summary: Burnham has canceled all public engagements following his father's death. He previously stated his father suffered from Alzheimer's. His father was unaware Burnham became prime minister.

headline: Farage says £72m donations are compliant 'with the law today'
summary: Farage claims £72m in donations comply with current legal standards. Ministers propose a £100,000 annual cap on expat donations. The cap would be backdated to March 25, 2026.

headline: What you need to know about the latest donations to Reform UK
summary: Henry Zeffman explains the £72m in recent donations to Reform UK. The report details the sources of these significant funds. Get insights into the financial backing of the political party.

headline: Member of UK armed forces dies in road traffic incident in Ukraine
summary: A UK armed forces member has died in Ukraine. The death resulted from a road traffic incident. It is not believed to be due to hostile action.
